input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space, with glassmorphism HUD, zero external dependencies.
constraints: Only one file: index.html with inline <style> and <script>; no external URLs, fonts, images or libraries.
Page background and canvas clear color #060913; html/body margin 0, overflow hidden.
One <canvas id="sim"> covering full window (position fixed, 100vw x 100vh); on resize set canvas.width/height = innerWidth/innerHeight * devicePixelRatio and ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame with delta time (clamp dt to max 0.05s).
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd27a -> #ff8a3d -> transparent) plus a corona whose radius pulses subtly with Math.sin(time).
At least 5 planets in an array, each with distinct orbit radius, angular speed, color and size (e.g. #8fd3ff, #ff7a7a, #7dffb0, #ffd27a, #c59bff, #ff9de2). Draw faint orbit path circles.
At least 3 moons total orbiting their parent planets (each moon with own radius, speed, color).
Each planet keeps a trail history of recent positions (~40-60 points) drawn as fading line segments/dots with decreasing alpha; when trails are OFF, trails are not drawn and history is cleared.
Background starfield of at least 200 stars with random positions (regenerated on resize), each twinkling via alpha = base + amplitude*sin(time*speed+phase).

HUD overlay: a <div id="hud"> fixed top-left with glassmorphism: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px) (plus -webkit-backdrop-filter), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, light text, system-ui font.
HUD button <button id="playBtn"> toggles pause; label text exactly 'Pause' while running and 'Play' while paused.
HUD button <button id="trailsBtn"> toggles trails; label text exactly 'Trails: ON' or 'Trails: OFF'. Trails start ON.

HUD button <button id="resetBtn"> label 'Reset': resets simulation time to 0, planet/moon angles to initial values, clears trails and all burst particles, sets speed to 1.0 (slider and readout), and unpauses.
HUD contains exactly <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0"> and a <span id="speedVal"> showing live multiplier formatted like '1.0x' updated on input event.

HUD stats: <span id="fps"> (integer FPS, smoothed, updated ~every 0.5s), <span id="simTime"> (simulation time in seconds with 1 decimal, e.g. '12.3'), <span id="particles"> (current burst particle count integer).
Simulation time advances by dt*speed only when not paused; orbits use simulation time so pause freezes them; starfield twinkle may keep animating.

Clicking (pointerdown/click) on the canvas spawns a radial burst of 60-120 glowing particles at the click point (use clientX/clientY in CSS pixels), random angles and speeds, velocity damping each frame (e.g. v *= Math.pow(0.9, dt*60) or similar), life decreasing to fade out alpha; remove dead particles. Draw particles with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' and a small radial glow. Particles update only when not paused.
Clicks on the HUD must not spawn bursts (HUD is outside canvas; HUD pointer events don't propagate to canvas).

Expose window.app = { get paused(), get trails(), get speed(), get simTime(), get particleCount(), planets, moons, spawnBurst(x,y) } where planets and moons are the arrays (planets.length>=5, moons.length>=3).
Valid JavaScript, no console errors.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#sim"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"js":"window.app.planets.length>=5 && window.app.moons.length>=3"},{"js":"document.querySelector('#speed').min==='0.2' && document.querySelector('#speed').max==='3.0' && document.querySelector('#speed').step==='0.1'"},{"text":"#speedVal","match":"1\\.0x"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^Pause$"},{"text":"#trailsBtn","match":"Trails: ON"},{"expect":"moving"},{"click":"canvas#sim"},{"js":"window.app.particleCount>0"},{"js":"parseInt(document.querySelector('#particles').textContent)>=0"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^Play$"},{"js":"window.app.paused===true"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"click":"#trailsBtn"},{"text":"#trailsBtn","match":"Trails: OFF"},{"js":"(function(){var s=document.querySelector('#speed');s.value='2.5';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return window.app.speed===2.5 && document.querySelector('#speedVal').textContent.indexOf('2.5')>=0})()"},{"click":"#resetBtn"},{"js":"window.app.speed===1 && window.app.particleCount===0 && window.app.simTime<0.5 && window.app.paused===false"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor==='rgb(6, 9, 19)'"}]}

I've created `index.html` using Tandem. It's a single file with no external dependencies. It has a glowing star with a pulsing corona, 6 planets and at least 3 moons with fading trails, a twinkling starfield of 200+ stars, and a frosted-glass control panel. Clicking the canvas sends out a burst of glowing particles that slow down and fade away.

Tandem's automated browser test passed. It checked that the controls work: Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, the 0.2–3.0 speed slider and its live readout, and that a click creates particles. It also checked the page loads without errors. In the first version the FPS, time and particle numbers had no labels, so I sent it back once, and the panel now reads "FPS 60 · Time 4.1 s · Particles 0".
